structure.unit: Other Regulated Providers of Financial Services

law.catch_line: Record and notice of revocation or suspension
law.text:
Whenever the Commission revokes or suspends a license issued pursuant to this chapter, it shall:
Enter an order to that effect, which order shall set forth its findings;
Compile a record containing (i) a summary of the evidence, (ii) the findings with respect thereto, (iii) the order, and (iv) the reasons supporting the revocation or suspension; and
Serve a copy of the order upon the licensee.
